build_EfficientGraphAttentionBlock: build an EfficientGraphAttentionBlock module with graph attention, feedforward, normalization, and stochastic depth layers
build_EfficientGraphAttention: build an EfficientGraphAttention module with multi-head self-attention, frequency embeddings, and graph attention aggregation
run_EfficientGraphAttentionBlock_forward: run the EfficientGraphAttentionBlock forward pass on graph data with node and edge features
run_multi_head_self_attention: run the multi-head self-attention mechanism with optional frequency vector embeddings and attention masks
review_graph_attention_aggregate: review the graph attention aggregation method that computes attention weights and aggregates edge outputs to nodes
